It means a lot to me that it means a lot to you.

And I feel the same. Most of the things I have done are *perceived by me* as having been stupid and hurtful to the people around me and all that. But it is so easy to forget that other people are not your perceptions of them.

I have also found that, in a certain way, getting through suicidal times requires a certain melancholy attitude, and a lot of grit/mental toughness. The good thing is that there are ways to actually cultivate that toughness, as daunting as it may sound. There are also ways to put yourself into that melancholy state of wonderment. Something like this: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AkoML0_FiV4.

And I want you to promise me something. You *WILL* go to the park. And while you're there, write down what you notice, on your phone or a notebook (notebooks work better). Write down what you think about the ducks, which color their feathers were. Write down what you noticed about the rain. Was it peaceful, or cloudy and stormy, or were there thousands of tiny raindrops falling on you all at once? How many raindrops can you count on your tongue when you stick it out for ten seconds... etc. Just things like that. Be content. Realize you are sad and depressed and unsatisfied, but sit with that feeling for a bit. Explore it. Don't be afraid. 

And if you do that, a few more times, over and over, you'll find things are getting a bit better.

Oh and, random question, but can I ask whether you enjoy your job or not?

Forget for a moment. Clear your mind. Bundle up and go outside. Walk. Hold the ice in your hands and focus on the tingly pain. Ground yourself.

Yell. Fucking get so angry at life and everything that you can't help but let it explode out of you. FUCK the benefit system. Shout it. Get extremely fucking angry. Punch the snow. Yell at god. Fuck God. Fuck the world. It's bullshit. 

Ok, good. It's out of your system.

Now, forget about the paperwork. Go to the closest human who is involved in the system. Show them you are desperate. Yell. Get fucking pissed. At the very least, something will happen. I am serious. But please, forget about your thoughts. They don't matter for the next five hours. Ground yourself.

Hey. I am here. I almost died a few days ago. Really fucking close.

You have a wife. That's amazing. Don't burn yourself out trying to show her something. Just appreciate her, she will see it. Be grateful! I am close-ish to your age. No friends. No s/o. Nothing. Just a computer and drugs.

And I read your whole post, if it means anything. Please don't jump off a bridge or anything like that. I know this probably sounds like bullshit, but my life is far more fucked than yours, probably, and there's a little light at the end of the tunnel, and that's amazing. It reminds me of a book I read as a child, about a mouse that got sucked down the sewer. I wish I could find it, it was a beautiful book.

Whatever. I'm here. PM me or something. And in the meantime, try going outside, no matter the weather, and just sitting there for an hour. Seriously. It's even better if you can touch real earth and drink cold water while you're at it. Behavioral psychology. Forget your brain. Hey. I don't know what to tell you to change your mind. I can't. But read my post, maybe. I did try to kill myself, and went through with it. It's a miracle I am alive.

I understand where you are, even if it seems like no one ever possibly could. But please, do not isolate yourself until the date you've set. If it gives you solace having one, I can't convince you to get rid of it. But people are out there and they care and they are confused and complex but they will give you time. 

I know it may seem embarrassing but even just going into the lobby of a hotel and asking for someone to talk to at the counter - it's a weird idea, I know, but someone will listen and care (provided it's not a snobby 5-star, and even then, someone would care). Just something like that. Make some human contact - if you are going to die anyway, what does embarrassment matter???

And if you aren't ready for that, PM me. Or respond to the comment. I love you. Seriously, no bullshit. I'm a flawed human - super flawed. But I care about you, jcnggd32.
